labels.label: possibly

evidence.quote: Participants must have primary platinum-refractory, platinum-resistant, or platinum-sensitive ovarian cancer.
Previously received therapies known to confer clinical benefit.
Prior therapy with a topoisomerase 1 inhibitor-based antibody drug conjugate.
Participants must have received up to 3 prior lines of therapy.

labels.note: Parts A/K accept pretreated PROC without a line cap (Part C/E/H caps at 3-4); payload of her current trial ADC is unknown.
